lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'm really sorry.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: You could have died because of me.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I can't apologize enough.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I didn't incur any major physical damage.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I... I'm glad to hear that.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: In fact, I haven't felt that stimulated in a long time. In some ways, I'm glad, haha.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Isn't that right, Yuni?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yuni...

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: ... Coo.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'm sorry to have made you go through that.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Out of selfish self-preservation, I accepted that offer,

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: and you suffered for it.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I don't expect you to accept my apology right away.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I just wanted to apologize for what I did wrong.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'm sorry. I really am.

lines.speaker: yuni_n
lines.text: ... Coo.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Haha, at least she responded.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... Thank you.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Now then, shall we move on to Siren's apology?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... I'm sorry for lying.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I thought that hiding the truth about where we actually were

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: was in your best interests.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I didn't want you to feel the terror I experienced when I was swallowed by Gluttony.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I'm terribly sorry.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: So you also got swallowed up by Gluttony?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Yes, a long time ago. I was eaten and ended up here.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: And you created this place while you were in here?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... That's right.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: To think this cavernous space is all something's throat...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Gluttony must be really enormous.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Then what was all that silver liquid?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: That was its digestive acid.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You mean...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: like stomach acid?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Any object that comes into contact with it melts and transforms into more silver liquid.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Once that's happened to you,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Gluttony absorbs the silver liquid and transfers it to energy,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: which it then uses as to fuel itself.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: If this stuff can dissolve seemingly anything,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: what about the membrane surrounding us?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: When my bubbles come into contact with the liquid, they twist and contort, but don't dissolve.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: It's like two armies battling for territory,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: and the outcome of the battle can shift based on the quantity of each army.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: So everything outside this membrane is that digestive acid?
Little Mermaid shakes her head.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Not quite.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: The digestive acid is released in cycles.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: On top of that, it can't affect natural substances, so the seawater here is real.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Is that why the fish are still alive?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: That's why leaving here without the bubbles is impossible.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: If one drop of that silver liquid touches you,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: you'll melt instantly.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... That's the reason you stopped me from going outside.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'm sorry for being so reckless.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Things may have gone a bit sideways back there,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: but we're still sticking to the original plan, right?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: About that...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I think I can get you out faster.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: You can?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Really? How?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: The silver liquid came out earlier than usual,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: so I think I can make the bubble faster than before.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Is that possible?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Remember what I said before;

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: the bubble tree only collects the energy present in the silver liquid.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: As a result, I think I can create the bubbles about a week ahead of schedule.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: That quick?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: So we potentially only have a week until we get out of here?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Ah... I see.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Mori?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Oh, it... it's nothing.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: It's just that this is all suddenly moving so fast.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You're right.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: It does feel like everything's sped up all of a sudden.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I'm going to go and get busy making the bubbles.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: In the meantime, you all can take it easy and prepare to depart.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah, and one more thing.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: There still might be some silver liquid in the clearing,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: so you should steer clear of that area for the time being.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: You think there's still some lingering in the clearing?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Yes, so you must stay away from there at all costs, understand?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... Right. Okay.
That night in the clearing.
Little Mermaid approaches the massive bubble positioned in the clearing.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... As I expected.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: The energy isn't decreasing.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: That's the AA Pillar, right?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Why are you...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You've saved my life twice now.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: What's so strange about me wanting to spend some time with you?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... Mihara.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Siren, you're hiding something from us, aren't you?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: And it's got something to do with this AA Pillar

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: and how it's made of bubbles.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: How did you...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I found it strange that you were trying so hard to

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: keep us away from this clearing.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I naturally concluded that something of interest must be here.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: After mulling it over for a while, I quickly came to an answer.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Something must have happened to the AA Pillar.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Siren.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Are we in danger?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: No. It's okay.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I can still fix it.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: It's fine.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Then let us help you fix it.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Once we've done that, you can get us out of here.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Doesn't that work fine as well?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: No... that won't work.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: It will take too long.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I can't make you wait that long.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Don't lie.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: It's because you're putting your own life on the line, isn't it?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Siren.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You saved my life twice now.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Now it's time for us to return the favor.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Please, let us help you.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... Thank you. Mihara.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: But I can't.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I promised that I would get you, Yuni, and Mori out of here.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I intend to keep that promise.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: What if we refuse to leave?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: What if we stay here with you?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I will use my Kotodama.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: If I have to, I will use that to make you leave this place.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You'd really go that far in order to get us out?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Because you're my friends. You helped me forget all of the loneliness I've had to endure for so long.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You all are precious to me, and I want to save you.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I hope you can understand that.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: But Siren...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Please. I'm begging you.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: *Sigh*...

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: All right. Fine.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Meeting you has been the happiest thing for me.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: ... Me too.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: ... Siren.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: With your power, we're sure to get out here,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: but remember:

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: A child who is starved for affection

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: can never abandon the person who gave them love.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: That is why the responsibility lies with the one who gave the love.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hehe, there will come a day when you understand.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... Ooh?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Down the road, you'll experience it first hand.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah, ooh...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Actually...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I also wanted to say something to you.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: What's that?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... It's about the core Yuni has.
